propositions: Bare-repository fixture commands fail with exit 128 under safe.bareRepository=explicit when using implicit discovery (cwd or git -C) instead of explicit --git-dir targeting.

git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/tickets in test fixture setup fail before test bodies execute under protected bare-repository policy on hosts configured with safe.bareRepository=explicit.

Generic Git helpers that use cwd or git -C targeting must explicitly identify bare test repositories with --git-dir to function under protected safe.bareRepository=explicit policy while preserving worktree helper semantics.

Test fixture initialization and infra/scripts/prepare_reclaim_backup.py restore operations require explicit bare-repository targeting to remain portable across default and protected Git safe.bareRepository configurations without mutation of host/global/system settings.
